title: Write-ahead landing so a crash cannot reopen an approved gate after the base branch moved
observation: A crash_after_land kill-point found runs where main had been fast-forwarded but the reloaded record still showed the consequential_repository_write gate open (3 violations in 40 seeds); a later rejection would contradict an effect that already happened.
suggested_direction: Persist the approval and a landing 'intended' marker before landing; on the next tick, finish an intended landing idempotently.
acceptance: 0 landing-invariant violations over >= 80 hunted seeds with landing kill-points
Regression test for the crash window
